outcome: Maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality (implied)
Fetal distress (meconium staining, fetal heart rate decelerations)
cohort: The study included pregnant women diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, followed from admission until hospital discharge after delivery.
finding: 72.5% of primigravida and 50% of women in the recurrent group with pregnancy-induced hypertension delivered beyond 37 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean sections were performed in 17 cases within the recurrent group, specifically for those with a previous caesarean section.
